g.title: CurrentTileMemory
g.text: Current GPU model — overlapped tile export and geometry lookahead
N20K-SYS-0.1 — exact native ports, ordered commands and shared SDRAM

g.title: cluster_fetch
g.text: Command fetch — SDRAM records, one shared Reader and bounded fields

g.title: cluster_draw
g.text: Primitive loop — current draw and one-record lookahead run concurrently

g.title: cluster_export
g.text: Completed-tile export — all color and depth values persist by pass completion

g.title: cluster_memory
g.text: Shared memory controller — six owned native slots, one physical SDR bus

g.title: cluster_parallel
g.text: Other operations and independently advancing display

g.title: submit
g.text: Front / sealed targets cannot be written
Invalidate texture tags for newly uploaded contents

g.title: descriptor
g.text: Clear RGB565 / D24 and tile-table address

g.title: entry
g.text: Empty bins still resolve both attachments

g.title: reader
g.text: Same established word enters RAM + fields
READ_MEMORY later streams native RAM reads

g.title: loadop
g.text: CLEAR: write constants into resident ports
LOAD: per row fetch color 64 B / depth 128 B
Prime + 32 resident writes per loaded row

g.title: clients
g.text: Host / Command / Tile / Texture / Copy / Scanout
One owned ≤16-word x32 slot per client
Two native x16 banks each: 12 total
Write requests / read responses share storage
One synchronous word port per direction

g.title: banksets
g.text: Two physical bank sets; 3 native banks each
One read + one write per bank / edge
Role selector routes ports; no pixel-array copy

g.title: reference
g.text: One reference lookahead, no record cache
Record refetched for each tile reference

g.title: words
g.text: Word-wide tile source through native ports
Color: two 16-bit pixel reads per 32-bit word
Depth: parallel low/high read → D24/U32 word
One staged 32-bit client word / eligible edge

g.title: draw
g.text: Capture next primitive only after prior drain
Current primitive owns captured tile registers

g.title: texture
g.text: Texture cache / copy scratch: 1 native bank
One outstanding miss; younger lookups held
Next slot read overlaps current low-half write

g.title: lookahead
g.text: Reader + field bank fetch following record
No second record RAM or decoded-field bank
Decode/fault transition after current draw drains

g.title: exchange
g.text: Wait for previous export to release its banks
Exchange resident/export roles on one edge

g.title: background
g.text: Background export of completed bank set
Next tile initializes and draws in other set
Three existing staging banks now use 1024 words

g.title: serial
g.text: Store reads resident bank ports directly

g.title: rows
g.text: Color 64 B, depth-low-half 64 B, high-half 64 B
One owned Tile slot; backpressure retained

g.title: done
g.text: Mark target color + shared depth valid
PRESENT separately waits for vertical blank

g.title: scan
g.text: One 32-bit hold → two RGB565 FIFO writes
Underflow blanks until next vertical blank
PRESENT swaps only at vertical blank

g.title: arb
g.text: Scanout quota ≤4 grants while others wait

g.title: uploads
g.text: Execute after earlier pass releases resources

g.title: sdr
g.text: Sequential aligned BL8 x32 physical bursts

g.title: memory
g.text: 403.2 MB/s raw peak at assumed 100.8 MHz

g.title: copy
g.text: Reuse cache bank as ≤640-pixel row scratch
Read entire row before writing it

g.title: accounting
g.text: Each pass stores 1,843,200 useful color+depth bytes; LOAD of both adds 1,843,200 read bytes
Boot explicitly writes 2,457,600 attachment bytes; exclude boot when measuring steady-state submissions
39 native BSRAM = 14 renderer + 25 system; 46/48 native 18×18 DSP equivalents
One resident +one completed tile use two existing three-bank sets selected by a role mux
Eight 64-bit optimization counters; bounded lookahead/export controls; no hidden record payload storage
Fit and achieved clock unproven; model FPS is not measured FPGA performance
Host observers, CPU texture snapshots and diagnostics add no GPU memory ports
Solid teal: data. Dashed blue: control. Dotted purple: shared resource. HDMI signaling excluded.
